def capinfo(f):
    s=f.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<=16:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],min(cols),max(cols),min(rows),max(rows)))
    return sorted(out)
for i in range(4):
    action(['RIGHT'])
    print('after RIGHT', i+1, capinfo(current_frame), 'level_completed:', last_action_result['level_completed'])
